label: Business Card
description: The m0saic business card, print-ready: US 3.5 x 2 in at 300 DPI on MOO's bleed box (1098 x 648 px; Vistaprint / FedEx presets too), light (the solutions look) or dark (the navy card). Front: the brand field, the M lockup and your contact. Back: a big QR to m0saic.io/solutions, the hello-world card, or any shipped template rendered live with a QR that opens it on Mosaic Web. One render, two PNGs (front + back).

name.label: Name
name.description: Your name — the bold line on the front. Double-click it to add any contact line that is empty.

role.label: Role
role.description: Role / company line under the name. Empty removes it.

email.label: Email
email.description: Email address, set in the mono face. Empty removes it.

site.label: Site
site.description: Website, set in the mono face. Empty removes it.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: Social handle, printed beside the site. Empty removes it.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: "light" — the m0saic.io solutions look: an ivory page, warm tiles, ink letters; "dark" — the navy card, its tiles lifted so the pattern survives print.

back.label: Back
back.description: What the back shows: "solutions" — a big QR to the industry solutions page; "hello-world" — the hello-world card with a QR to it on Mosaic Web; "template" — any other shipped template, rendered live, with a QR that opens it.

backTemplate.label: Back template
backTemplate.description: Which shipped template the back shows (rendered live, with a QR that opens it on Mosaic Web).

qrUrl.label: QR link
qrUrl.description: What the back's QR opens — the industry solutions page, so one card serves every show. Printed beside it as typed (no https://).

backTitle.label: Back title
backTitle.description: The bold line beside the QR. Double-click it to add a last line.

backLine.label: Back line
backLine.description: A last line under the link, in the mono face — a booth number, say. Empty removes it.

backImage.label: Back picture
backImage.description: One picture beside a smaller QR, cropped to 16:9 — a store's ad, say. Empty: the big QR alone.

bleed.label: Bleed
bleed.description: Printer bleed per side: "moo" (MOO — 3.66 x 2.16 in, 1098 x 648 px at 300 DPI, exact), "none" (trim only, 3.5 x 2 in), "sixteenth" (Vistaprint), "eighth" (FedEx Office / Staples).

dpi.label: DPI
dpi.description: Print resolution in dots per inch — every dimension scales with it. 300 is press standard.

fieldOpacity.label: Field opacity
fieldOpacity.description: Tint of the field tiles over the page (0–1). Empty = the theme's: 0.7 on light (a visible brick, still soft), 0.5 on dark. Paper prints no backlight: on dark, under about 0.4 the brick prints as solid black.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: Accent colour — the M, the wordmark's zero and the QR.

guides.label: Proof guides
guides.description: Draw the trim (orange) and safe-area (green) outlines for proofing. Off for the press file.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: overlay the layout contract (every mark keeps its aspect, a picture on the back keeps its own, every glyph stays inside the safe area).
